title: GRADUATED SET OF 4 PYREX GLASS...
reason: Complete four-piece Pyrex Butterfly Gold Cinderella nesting bowl set, a popular retro collectable; bases not shown so marks and chips underneath are unchecked.
findings: Set of four graduated double-spouted Pyrex 'Cinderella' opal glass nesting mixing bowls in the Butterfly Gold pattern: two bowls have a gold-orange glaze with white butterfly and flower decoration, and two have white glaze with gold decoration. The alternating colours and pattern match the Corning Pyrex Butterfly Gold set of the 1970s to early 80s, a popular retro collectable; the title only says Pyrex glass bowls. No Pyrex base marks, model numbers or size markings are visible because no bowl base is photographed. Handwritten price stickers on the spouts are illegible. The complete set of four is shown nested in photo 2.
condition: Glaze looks glossy and even; the gold decoration on the smallest white bowl looks slightly patchy or thin in the photo; no chips, cracks or heavy cutlery marking visible from the angles shown; interiors look clean. Bases and underside rims not shown.
rescore_note: Photos show the standard alternating gold and white Pyrex Butterfly Gold Cinderella nest with all four bowls present, glossy and no chips seen; a sought-after retro set, held back only by unseen bases and slight gold wear on the smallest bowl; upper part of the $80-200 band (judgement, no live comps this run).
